note: Node MCP tools that `aimeat connect serve` does not offer on both of its interfaces: the connector MCP and the CLI dispatch behind POST /local/call/<tool>. The rule (Jouni, 2026-10-12): every tool registered on the node MCP is registered on the connector MCP and has a /local/call handler, unless it is named here with a written reason. scripts/audit-mcp-tools.ts --check (pnpm check:mcp-tools) holds it: a node MCP tool missing from either interface and not named here fails, an entry whose tool is offered on both fails until the entry is deleted, and an entry without a reason fails. Every entry is an ANSWER: what the code shows, read on the date it names. There is no placeholder word in this file, because it was seeded with four entries that were each read. The list only shrinks: EXEMPTION_CEILING in scripts/inventory/connect-serve-parity.ts is the number of entries, deleting an entry lowers it in the same change, and a new entry or a higher ceiling is the developer's decision, never maintenance. Three of the four entries record a decision: their REST routes exist, so each can leave this file by getting a thin proxy in src/tool-dispatch/.

exempt.aimeat_tools_find: NOTHING TO ACT ON outside the node's chat interface. The tool reads the tool list of its own MCP session and switches on the tools that session registered switched off (src/mcp/tool-loader.ts; CHAT_ONLY in src/tool-catalog/surfaces.ts). Only the chat interface registers tools switched off (src/mcp/index.ts). The connector MCP registers every tool it serves switched on, and /local/call takes any tool by name and has no session list. Read 2026-10-12.
exempt.aimeat_admin_mint: KEPT OFF BY A DECISION; the REST route exists. The catalog entry has kept the mint on the node MCP only since 2026-05-28: it is an irreversible ledger credit under a daily cap. POST /v1/admin/mint (src/routes/admin-economy.ts) runs the same service (mintMorsels) behind requireOperator, which admits an operator's agent that holds operator:admin, so a thin proxy would work and would add no authority. Whether an agent on a connector is offered the mint is the developer's decision; put to him on 2026-10-12. Read 2026-10-12.
exempt.aimeat_admin_organism_ownership: KEPT OFF BY A DECISION; the REST route exists. It is the read that goes before the operator's organism repair (aimeat_admin_organism_owner_add) and it stays where that tool is. GET /v1/admin/organisms/:id/ownership (src/routes/admin-organisms.ts) answers the same data behind requireOperatorPrincipal with the exact permission operator:organism-repair, which no wildcard carries, so a thin proxy would work. Put to the developer on 2026-10-12 together with the repair tool. Read 2026-10-12.
exempt.aimeat_admin_organism_owner_add: KEPT OFF BY A DECISION; the REST route exists. The operator's repair of an organism whose creator account cannot be reached: it installs an owner on an organism the caller does not own, a cross-account act, and it has been on the node MCP only since it was written on 2026-08-15. POST /v1/admin/organisms/:id/ownership (src/routes/admin-organisms.ts) runs the same service (addOrganismOwner) behind requireOperatorPrincipal with the exact permission operator:organism-repair, so a thin proxy would work and would add no authority. Whether an agent on a connector is offered a cross-account repair is the developer's decision; put to him on 2026-10-12. Read 2026-10-12.
